rules.title: Boston fair housing discrimination rules
rules.requirement: In Boston, property owners may not discriminate when renting housing based on protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, disability, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity or expression, age, sexual orientation, marital status, rental assistance, family status, or military status.

coverage.summary: Applies to renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for housing in the City of Boston.

rules.interaction: The page states the commission enforces local, state, and federal fair housing laws.
rules.quoted_span:
In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.
You can’t discriminate someone based on their:
Race
Color
Religion
Disability
National Origin
Ancestry
Sex
